A '''hepatizon dolabra''' is a [[dolabra]] of the [[Hepatizon equipment|hepatizon]] tier, made by smithing a [[copper axe]] or [[copper dolabra]] with [[hepatizon alloy]] and a [[smithing upgrade template]].

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

This upgrade needs a [[smithing upgrade template]]; without one, the same copper axe and alloy make a [[hepatizon axe]].

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===
It breaks pickaxe and axe blocks at speed 15 and has 1000 durability. It has no obsidian rule, so unlike the hepatizon pickaxe it harvests obsidian.

Matcha Flavoured adds beds, candles, cacti and honeycomb blocks to the blocks that axes break quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|7}} damage at an attack speed of 1. While held in the main hand it adds 0.005 to movement speed, 5% of the player's base speed.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Copper|blocks of copper}}. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Trading ===
{{Uses}}

An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys it for one [[hepatizon alloy]], so the alloy can be reused.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/hepatizon_dolabra.json}}</ref>

== Notes ==
* Hepatizon tools reuse the stone tools' item IDs, so they cannot be melted down in a blast furnace.

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.10|Renamed from "Bronze" in the language file only, so existing items keep working. Hepatizon equipment was buffed. A [[weaponsmith]] now takes the item back in exchange for its alloy, so players can rebuild it with updated stats.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|The upgrade now keeps the base item's enchantments. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip. Mining speed raised from about 12 to 15.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older copies can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>. Dolabras began to shift from weapon hybrids to pure axe and pickaxe tools; the release notes say their damage and weapon intrinsics will be reduced over time.}}
}}
